baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberately acquired speech act becomes protective equipment; that protection enables both withdrawal from the route and the blocking of others from it, two live valences of صَدُّوا.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition branch makes the oath-shield a deliberately appropriated instrument rather than a spontaneous excuse.
The oath branch supplies the speech act that is converted from an assurance into defensive equipment.
The protective-screen branch gives the oaths an operational role: they absorb challenge and preserve freedom of action.
The turning-and-diverting branch keeps both self-deflection and active obstruction available as the shield's output.
The extended traversable route makes the harm directional and access-related rather than merely doctrinal.

changed_reading.before: They swear falsely, turn away, and receive punishment.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately convert oath-making into protective infrastructure that lets them divert themselves and others from a traversable divine route.

baseline_models.mechanism: The oath can project right and power while the shield hides what lies behind it; the closing punishment therefore answers the performance by exposing and lowering the status it tried to preserve.

activation_trace.role: The right-and-power branch lets the oath project authority, entitlement, and capacity to repel challenge.
The concealment branch makes that projected authority a cover over an unseen contrary alignment.
The punitive-pain branch supplies an imposed consequence rather than a merely reputational failure.
The abasement branch specifies that the consequence strips standing and treats the protected persona as contemptible.

changed_reading.before: Humiliating punishment is a generic penalty appended to the offense.
changed_reading.after: The penalty is a status reversal: the oath's display of right and power is uncovered, made weightless, and publicly lowered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening legal sequence shows speech attempting to manufacture a false relation, then answers it with embodied cost, liberation, and a discriminating boundary. Against that sequence, the oath-shield is procedural evasion: formally potent words are used to preserve action while insulating the speaker from the liability those words should create.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch anchors the focus mechanism in a formally weighty utterance.
The protective branch assigns that utterance the function of intercepting accountability.
The branch of asserting what is not so supplies a prior case in which words counterfeit a real status.
The crafted-speech branch sharpens the false declaration into language deliberately made serviceable.
The freedom branch supplies a costly material repair that cannot be replaced by another verbal maneuver.
The discriminating-limit branch frames the repair sequence as a real boundary that protective speech cannot erase.

structural_cues: 58:2 calls a relational declaration both objectionable speech and falsehood; 58:3-4 answer it with ordered obligations before renewed contact.
The focus repeats the pattern of consequential speech but explicitly names the speech itself as protective equipment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false status-making speech, material release, and binding limits; I infer that the focus oath similarly exploits verbal form to evade cost. A narrower reading of ordinary defensive perjury remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The oaths are lies used to escape an accusation.
changed_reading.after: The oaths are a form of procedural arbitrage, using the authority of binding speech to evade the very accountability such speech ordinarily establishes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated private counsel is eventually coupled to an advance transfer of value. That pairing makes the oath-shield look like the inverse device: a costless verbal credential that purchases trust or access while allowing harmful coordination and obstruction to continue.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch supplies a high-trust verbal token that can circulate without proving the conduct behind it.
The protective branch lets that token screen participants and their coordinated activity from scrutiny.
The private-counsel branch locates speech inside restricted access and selective interpersonal exchange.
The transfer-of-wealth branch supplies an up-front cost that tests and regulates access to private speech.

structural_cues: 58:7-13 repeatedly returns to private counsel, its harmful and beneficial contents, and its regulation.
58:12 places value before private speech, while 58:13 immediately registers reluctance to bear that cost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restricted speech plus a required up-front cost; I infer by contrast that an oath can function as a cheap trust credential. It may instead be only a defensive statement with no access-granting role.

changed_reading.before: The oath hides an individual's misconduct after the fact.
changed_reading.after: The oath also works prospectively as a cheap credential inside a communication network, preserving access and coordination while shielding the resulting obstruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Swearing immediately precedes the focus and recurs after resurrection in the same human-facing manner. Knowing falsehood and mistaken self-assessment coexist, so the shield is not a single alibi but a rehearsed protocol that protects both social standing and the actors' own false picture of their position.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch anchors the focus in the same sworn-speech practice repeated around it.
The concealment branch expands the shield from hiding conduct from others to hiding position from oneself.
The explicit swearing branch identifies the immediately preceding behavior that the focus recasts as a shield.
The falsehood branch establishes that the oath's protective force is detached from truth.
The disclosed-knowledge branch prevents the initial lie from being reduced to innocent error.
The repeated swearing branch carries the same audience-conditioned performance into the scene of resurrection.
The supposition branch shows that practiced deception now coexists with a miscalculated sense of standing.

structural_cues: 58:14 places knowing false swearing immediately before 58:16.
58:18 repeats swearing with an explicit comparison to how they swear to the human addressee, then reports their false estimate of being on something.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, known falsehood, and later miscalculation; I infer that repeated outward defense has become inward epistemic armor. Fully deliberate lying without self-deception remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield is a tactical lie for one worldly audience.
changed_reading.after: It is a rehearsed, audience-adaptive defense that persists under ultimate exposure and helps maintain a false estimate of the swearers' own standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives the actors apparent agency: they take up oaths and deploy them. 58:19 reverses the grammar of control: an outside power overwhelms and gathers them, remembrance is displaced, and the result is a consolidated faction. Their shielded obstruction can therefore be read as captured agency masquerading as strategy.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition branch presents the actors as makers and owners of their protective device.
The diversion branch supplies the behavior that must be reclassified when their agency is reversed.
The overpowering-and-gathering branch reverses the apparent ownership: the takers are themselves under possession.
The loss-from-remembrance branch supplies the cognitive effect of that takeover.
The recollection branch identifies what the takeover removes from active presence.
The faction branch turns individual defensive acts into the behavior of a group consolidated around one orientation.

structural_cues: 58:16 uses an active plural for taking the shield; 58:19 installs a different subject who overpowers them and causes forgetting.
The sequence moves from an acquired object to acquired people, then names their group formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies takeover, caused forgetting, and factional consolidation; I infer the backward arrow that these conditions generate the oath habit and obstruction. Independent strategic agency can still coexist with capture.

changed_reading.before: They are sovereign strategists who wield oaths as protection.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent mastery is itself evidence of captivity: the acquired shield is an instrument and symptom of the actors having been acquired.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus oath can carry a secondary claim of right and repelling power, but the next sequence assigns abasement to the opposing side and victory, bundled strength, and honor elsewhere. The humiliating punishment thus decommissions counterfeit authority rather than merely adding pain.

activation_trace.role: The right-and-force branch lets the sworn shield project legitimate capacity to repel challenge.
The contemptuous-abasement branch makes loss of standing integral to the punishment.
The breaking-under-force branch specifies the social and political low position assigned to the opposing camp.
The overcoming-force branch relocates effective victory away from the oath-protected actors.
The bundled-strength branch supplies a coherent, gathered power unlike the verbal projection in the shield.
The honor-after-lowening branch completes the contrast between real dignity and the status the punishment removes.

structural_cues: The focus closes with a status-marked punishment; 58:20 immediately names the opponents among the lowest.
58:21 follows abasement with a decree of victory and a paired assertion of strength and honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abasement followed by victory, strength, and honor; I connect that contrast to the power sense latent in أَيْمَان. The word can remain simply 'oaths,' making the power contrast secondary rather than lexical foreground.

changed_reading.before: The oath has legal force, and humiliation is a generic aftereffect.
changed_reading.after: The oath-shield counterfeits power and entitlement; humiliation is the public cancellation of that claim when effective force and honor are reassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus constructs an external enclosure by acquiring a جُنَّة of speech. The closing ayah instead inscribes faith internally, supplies strengthening, and admits people into جَنَّات. The shared root pivots from a manufactured screen that blocks a path to a granted, living enclosure reached after inward alignment.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition branch makes the focus protection self-manufactured and possessed.
The defensive-cover branch supplies the closed exterior protection that enables obstruction.
The binding-inscription branch relocates security from performed speech to an established inward determination.
The heart branch identifies the interior site of that determination, opposite the external screen.
The strengthening-support branch supplies protection as received aid rather than self-fabricated cover.
The entry branch changes protection from something held in front of oneself into a space one is admitted within.
The garden branch activates the same root as a sheltering, cultivated destination rather than a defensive screen.

structural_cues: 58:16 has people take a جُنَّة and then block a path; 58:22 has God admit people into جَنَّات with flowing rivers.
The closing sequence places inscription in hearts and strengthening before entry, reversing the focus sequence of outward speech, cover, and obstruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the جُنَّة/جَنَّات root recurrence and the exterior-to-interior sequence; I infer an evaluative reversal from counterfeit enclosure to granted enclosure. The recurrence may be resonance rather than a deliberate pun.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield is merely a temporary cover for misconduct.
changed_reading.after: It is a counterfeit enclosure: protection manufactured through concealment in place of the inwardly grounded, supported enclosure into which one must be admitted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins form-distant environmental branches rather than proposing their ordinary senses in the sentence. It remains anchored in four focus roots and yields a coherent material analogy; downstream prose should label it an exploratory hydraulic resonance, not a translation or exclusive interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱتَّخَذُوا ... جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ

activation_trace.role: The water-holding branch supplies an image of capture and impoundment for the act of taking.
The route-to-water branch makes obstruction a denial of access to a necessary flow.
The descending-rain branch turns the path into a vertical flow between source and recipient.
The sweet-water branch places the sought good and the named punishment in a sharp root-level reversal.

changed_reading.before: Obstruction is an abstract refusal or prevention.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, the oath-shield behaves like an impounding barrier that captures a shared life-giving flow, making self-protection and deprivation of others one act.

strongest_changes: The repeated swearing around 58:16 changes a tactical lie into durable social and epistemic armor.
58:19 reverses apparent agency: those who take a shield are revealed as people taken over and gathered into a faction.
58:22 turns the جُنَّة shield toward جَنَّات, contrasting manufactured external cover with inward inscription, received support, and granted enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact chain links performative speech, protection, directional obstruction, and status reversal; the context repeatedly replays each link in legal, communicative, cognitive, factional, and spatial forms without collapsing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: صَدُّوا can sustain self-turning and transitive blocking; the surrounding social sequence strengthens the latter without eliminating the former.
The power-and-right activation of أَيْمَان is secondary to its explicit oath sense.
The shield/garden and hydraulic activations are root-based resonances whose rhetorical prominence cannot be settled by this packet alone.
